candidates.tagline: School spent $60K on a robot teacher made by a sex-doll company
candidates.story: Salamanca City Central School District in rural upstate New York approved a $60,000 purchase of a humanlike AI robot named 'Sally' — built by Realbotix, whose sibling company manufactures hyper-realistic adult sex dolls — to teach high school students robotics; state education officials and the teachers union forced the school to pause the pilot after the manufacturer's product line was discovered.
candidates.why_funny: The school board vetted the robot's teaching credentials before anyone checked what else the manufacturer makes.
candidates.alt: A humanlike Realbotix humanoid robot with realistic silicone skin and facial features stands at the Realbotix booth at CES 2025 in Las Vegas, interacting with attendees

candidates.tagline: Samsung's $2,100 foldable: eight generations and still defeated by pocket dust
candidates.story: Samsung unveiled the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Z Fold 8 Ultra, and Z Flip 8 at Galaxy Unpacked on July 22, 2026 — all still rated IP48, which means they are not dustproof; while rivals Google, HONOR, vivo, and OPPO have achieved full IP68 dust-and-water resistance on their foldables, Samsung's flagship $2,100 phone can be damaged by the lint in your pocket, a flaw critics have flagged across all eight generations.
candidates.why_funny: Samsung has spent six years charging flagship prices for a folding phone that cannot survive the interior of a trouser pocket, while budget Android rivals quietly solved the problem years ago.
candidates.alt: A hand holding three Samsung Galaxy foldable phones — Galaxy Z Fold 8, Z Flip 8, and Z Fold 8 Ultra — side by side against a white background
